projects.name: Lake Mariner Data Campus
projects.quote: In addition to the 102 MW of revenue-generating critical IT capacity and 336 MW currently under construction at Lake Mariner, the Company is pursuing 250 MW of incremental power capacity, subject to applicable interconnection approval.

projects.name: CB-3 (Lake Mariner)
projects.quote: Operated 81 MW of revenue-generating critical IT capacity at Lake Mariner as of June 30, 2026 and completed delivery of CB-3 in early July, increasing revenue-generating capacity to 102 MW and satisfying the applicable conditions for $600 million of Google’s credit support for Fluidstack’s lease obligations to become effective.

projects.name: CB-4 (Lake Mariner)
projects.quote: The first CB-4 data hall has entered commissioning, with phased delivery and rent commencement expected during the second half of 2026, while CB-5 remains targeted to begin phased delivery in early 2027.

projects.name: CB-5 (Lake Mariner)
projects.quote: The first CB-4 data hall has entered commissioning, with phased delivery and rent commencement expected during the second half of 2026, while CB-5 remains targeted to begin phased delivery in early 2027.

projects.name: Justified Data Campus
projects.quote: Entered into a 20-year data center lease with Anthropic for approximately 401 MW of critical IT capacity at the Justified Data Campus.

projects.name: Muskie Data Campus
projects.quote: Acquired in May 2026, Muskie comprises approximately 308 acres in Eastern Kentucky.

projects.name: Kentucky Power Company electric service agreements (Muskie)
projects.quote: Electric service and related infrastructure agreements with Kentucky Power Company provide for up to 1 GW of contracted electric service, with initial service expected in the fourth quarter of 2028 and phased development thereafter.

projects.name: Chesapeake Data Campus
projects.quote: Subject to the remaining closing conditions and required approvals, the site could support an integrated generation, energy-storage and data center campus capable of scaling to up to 1 GW, with initial data center operations currently contemplated for 2030.

projects.name: Morgantown generating station
projects.quote: On July 29, 2026, FERC authorized the pending acquisition of the Morgantown generating station.

projects.name: Lake Hawkeye
projects.quote: Lake Hawkeye encompasses approximately 183 leased acres at a former industrial site with existing electrical infrastructure and, subject to permitting and site development, has the potential to support approximately 400 MW of gross capacity, or approximately 320 MW of critical IT load, with operations not currently contemplated until approximately 2029.
